title: APCNV-2023-8204-ZC-HCA
text:
APCNV-2023-8204-ZC-HCA  Council District: 6 – Padilla
  CEQA: ENV-2023-8205-MND (SCH No. 2026011067)  Last Day to Act: 08-07-26
  Plan Area: Mission Hills – Panorama City – North Hills  Continued from: 07-16-26
  Related Case: VTT-84182-SL-HCA

  PUBLIC HEARING – Completed June 9, 2026

  PROJECT SITE:  9247 North Wakefield Avenue

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Demolition of an existing single-family dwelling for the subdivision of one 24,008 gross square foot lot into
  eight small lots and for the construction of eight dwelling units, one on each lot. Each dwelling unit will have
  an attached garage with two parking spaces and there will be two guest parking spaces for the entire site.
  The eight dwelling units will each be two stories with a maximum height of 27 feet, six inches.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Sections 15162 and 15164, in consideration of the whole of the
  administrative record, that the Project was assessed in Mitigated Negative Declaration, No.
  ENV-2023-8205-MND as adopted on June 11, 2026, (“Mitigated Negative Declaration”), and no
  subsequent EIR, negative declaration, or addendum is required for approval of the Project; and
  2. Pursuant to Chapter 1 Section 12.32 Q of the Los Angeles Municipal Code, a Zone Change from the
  RA-1 (Residential Suburban Zone) to (T)(Q)RD2-1 (Restricted Density Multiple Dwelling Zone).

  Applicant:  Nousheen Bai Memon, Trustee of The Family Values Irrevocable Trust
  Representative: Kevin Kohan, Elevated Entitlements

  Staff:  Shane Strunk, Planning Assistant
  shane.strunk@lacity.org
  (213) 675-6022
